sentences.sentence: Pronunciation: hye-droe-KOE-done and a-SEET-a-MIN-oh-fen Generic name: hydrocodone bitartrate and acetaminophen Brand names: Hycet (discontinued), Lorcet (discontinued), Norco (discontinued), Verdrocet (discontinued), Vicodin (discontinued), Xodol , Zamicet (discontinued) Dosage form: oral tablet (2.5 mg/325 mg, 5 mg/325 mg, 7.5 mg/325 mg, 10 mg/325 mg), oral solution (10 mg/325 mg/15 mL) Drug class: Narcotic analgesic combinations
Medically reviewed by Carmen Pope, Senior Medical Editor, B. Pharm .
Last updated on Oct 1, 2026.

Hydrocodone and acetaminophen is a strong prescription combination pain medicine containing an opioid, hydrocodone, in addition to acetaminophen, which is used to manage moderate to moderately severe pain , when other pain treatments such as non-opioid pain medicines do not treat your pain well enough, or you cannot tolerate them.
An opioid pain medicine that can put you at risk for overdose and death.
Even if you take your dose correctly as prescribed, you are at risk for opioid addiction, abuse, and misuse that can lead to death.
Hydrocodone and acetaminophen is a Schedule II controlled substance .

All branded hydrocodone and acetaminophen ( Norco , Vicodin , Lortab , Hycet , Lorcet, Verdrocet , Xodol , Zamicet ) have been discontinued , but generic hydrocodone and acetaminophen tablets and oral solution is still available.
Hydrocodone and acetaminophen first gained FDA approval on May 3, 1982.

sentences.section_title: Important information about hydrocodone and acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Get emergency help right away if you take too many hydrocodone and acetaminophen tablets or oral solution (overdose).

sentences.section_title: Important information about hydrocodone and acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: When you first start taking hydrocodone and acetaminophen, when your dose is changed, or if you take too much (overdose), serious or life-threatening breathing problems that can lead to death may occur.

sentences.section_title: Important information about hydrocodone and acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Never give anyone else your hydrocodone and acetaminophen .

sentences.section_title: Important information about hydrocodone and acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: They could die from taking them.

sentences.section_title: Important information about hydrocodone and acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Store hydrocodone and acetaminophen away from children and in a safe place to prevent stealing or abuse.

sentences.section_title: Important information about hydrocodone and acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Selling or giving away hydrocodone and acetaminophen products is against the law.
The possible side effects of hydrocodone and acetaminophen are constipation, nausea, sleepiness, vomiting, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and abdominal pain.
Call your healthcare provider if you have any of these symptoms and they are severe.
Get emergency medical help if you have:
Trouble breathing
Shortness of breath
Fast heartbeat
Chest pain
Swelling of your face, tongue, or throat
Extreme drowsiness
Light-headedness when changing positions
Feeling faint
Agitation
High body temperature
Trouble walking
Stiff muscles
Mental changes such as confusion.
These are not all the possible side effects of hydrocodone and acetaminophen.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Do not take hydrocodone and acetaminophen if you have:
Severe asthma, trouble breathing, or other lung problems
A bowel blockage or a narrowing of the stomach or intestines
Signs of an allergy, such as a rash
Are allergic to any of its ingredients.
Before taking hydrocodone and acetaminophen, tell your healthcare provider if you have a history of:
Head injury, seizures
Liver, kidney, thyroid problems
Problems urinating
Pancreas or gallbladder problems
Abuse of street or prescription drugs, alcohol addiction, or mental health problems.
Tell your healthcare provider if you are:
Pregnant or planning to become pregnant.
Prolonged use of hydrocodone and acetaminophen during pregnancy can cause withdrawal symptoms in your newborn baby that could be life-threatening if not recognized and treated
Breastfeeding.
Hydrocodone and acetaminophen pass into breast milk and may harm your baby.
Carefully observe infants for increased sleepiness (more than usual), breathing difficulties, or limpness.
Seek immediate medical care if you notice these signs.
Taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, or herbal supplements.
Taking hydrocodone and acetaminophen with certain other medicines can cause serious side effects that could lead to death.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: When taking hydrocodone and acetaminophen:

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Do not change your dose .

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Take hydrocodone and acetaminophen exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Take your prescribed dose every four to six hours at the same time every day.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Do not take more than your prescribed dose.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: If you miss a dose, take your next dose at your usual time.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: If taking the oral solution, always use a graduated oral syringe or measuring cup to correctly measure your dose.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Never use a household teaspoon or tablespoon to measure your medicine.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Call your healthcare provider if the dose you are taking does not control your pain, if your pain gets worse, if you feel more sensitive to pain, or if you have new pain.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Do not take more medicine without first talking to your healthcare provider.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: If you have been taking hydrocodone and acetaminophen regularly, do not stop taking it without talking to your healthcare provider.

sentences.section_title: How Do I Take Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: After you stop taking hydrocodone and acetaminophen, flush any unused tablets or oral solution down the toilet .

sentences.section_title: What Should I Avoid While Taking Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: While taking hydrocodone and acetaminophen, DO NOT:

sentences.section_title: What Should I Avoid While Taking Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Drive or operate heavy machinery until you know how hydrocodone and acetaminophen affects you.

sentences.section_title: What Should I Avoid While Taking Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Hydrocodone and acetaminophen can make you sleepy, dizzy, or lightheaded.

sentences.section_title: What Should I Avoid While Taking Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Drink alcohol or use prescription or over-the-counter medicines that contain alcohol .

sentences.section_title: What Should I Avoid While Taking Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen
sentences.sentence: Using products containing alcohol during treatment with hydrocodone and acetaminophen may cause you to overdose and die.

sentences.section_title: Adult Dose of Hydrocodone And Acetaminophen for Moderate to Severe Pain
sentences.sentence: Doses should be individually titrated to provide adequate analgesia while minimizing adverse reactions.

sentences.section_title: Adult Dose of Hydrocodone And Acetaminophen for Moderate to Severe Pain
sentences.sentence: Because of the risks of addiction, abuse, and misuse, the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration consistent with individual patient treatment goals should be used.

sentences.section_title: Adult Dose of Hydrocodone And Acetaminophen for Moderate to Severe Pain
sentences.sentence: Monitor patients closely for respiratory depression within the first 24 to 72 hours of initiating therapy and following any increase in dose.
Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222.
An overdose of acetaminophen and hydrocodone can be fatal.

Acute overdosage with hydrocodone and acetaminophen can cause respiratory depression, sleepiness progressing to near-unconsciousness or coma, floppy muscles, cold and clammy skin, constricted pupils, and, in some cases, pulmonary edema, slow heartbeat, low blood pressure, partial or complete airway obstruction, unusual snoring, and death.
If the patient who has overdosed becomes very low in oxygen, pupils may become very dilated instead of constricted.
Your doctor may recommend that you get naloxone (a medicine to reverse an opioid overdose) and keep it with you at all times.
A person caring for you can give the naloxone if you stop breathing or don't wake up.
Your caregiver must still get emergency medical help and may need to perform CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) on you while waiting for help to arrive.
Anyone can buy naloxone from a pharmacy or local health department.
Make sure any person caring for you knows where you keep naloxone and how to use it.
The first signs of an acetaminophen overdose include loss of appetite, nausea , vomiting , stomach pain, sweating, and confusion or weakness.
Later symptoms may include pain in your upper stomach, dark urine, and yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes.

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: You may have breathing problems or withdrawal symptoms if you start or stop taking certain other medicines.

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: Tell your doctor if you also use an antibiotic , antifungal medication, heart or blood pressure medication, seizure medication, or medicine to treat HIV or hepatitis C.

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: Opioid medication can interact with many other drugs and cause dangerous side effects or death.

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: Be sure your doctor knows if you also use:

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: cold or allergy medicines, bronchodilator asthma/ COPD medication, or a diuretic ("water pill");

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: medicines for motion sickness , irritable bowel syndrome , or overactive bladder ;

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: other opioids - opioid pain medicine or prescription cough medicine;

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: a sedative like Valium - diazepam , alprazolam , lorazepam , Xanax , Klonopin , Versed , and others;

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: drugs that make you sleepy or slow your breathing - a sleeping pill, muscle relaxer, medicine to treat mood disorders or mental illness;

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: drugs that affect serotonin levels in your body - a stimulant, or medicine for depression , Parkinson's disease , migraine headaches, serious infections, or nausea and vomiting .

sentences.sentence: This list is not complete.

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: Other drugs may interact with acetaminophen and hydrocodone, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins , and herbal products .

sentences.section_title: What other drugs will affect hydrocodone and acetaminophen?
sentences.sentence: Remember, keep this and all other medicines out of the reach of children, never share your medicines with others, and use acetaminophen or hydrocodone only for the indication prescribed.
Vicodin contains a combination of acetaminophen and the opioid hydrocodone, whereas Apadaz is a combination of the prodrug, benzhydrocodone and acetaminophen.
When ingested, stomach enzymes cleave the benzhydrocodone prodrug and release the active parent drug hydrocodone.
